_doc: SINGLE SOURCE of the TLC run matrix: one entry = one .cfg, its constants, the
properties it checks, and the verdict the gate REQUIRES. `run-tlc.mjs` GENERATES
the .cfg files from here and refuses any deviation from `expect`.
expect.green = TRUE  -> TLC must find no error.
expect.violated       -> TLC must report EXACTLY that invariant/property violated.
A run whose verdict flips is a RED gate in BOTH directions: a sabotage that stops
biting is a spec that stopped meaning anything, and a known defect that goes green
means the engine was fixed and the check must move into the baseline.

runs.why: DESIGN AS SHIPPED. No loss, no write outside the lock, no re-delivery of a consumed doc, one split per invocation, and a consumed `once` always ends up delivered. SINCE 2026-08-20 it also carries AtMostOnceDelivery: the lock-less path stopped delivering `once` documents it cannot record, so the duplicate found by TLC is gone from the SHIPPED design and the invariant moved here — exactly where the witness cell said it should go.

LEGACY NEGATIVE-CHECK since 2026-08-20 — it no longer models the shipped engine, it models the design we LEFT, and it must stay RED for ever. It re-enables the old behaviour explicitly (FALLBACK_DELIVERS_ONCE) and shows the duplicate coming back: the lock-less fallback delivers a fresh `once` and records nothing, so the next leader re-decides it as fresh and delivers it a SECOND time. 🛑 Its value is anti-vacuity: if this run ever goes GREEN, AtMostOnceDelivery has stopped discriminating and the proof in Transport.cfg is hollow. NEVER delete it and NEVER make it green.

PROOF THAT A FIX EXISTS AND IS SUFFICIENT: if the lock-less path stops delivering unrecorded `once` documents, AtMostOnceDelivery holds WITHOUT costing NoWriteWithoutLock or liveness. It is a spec, not an engine change — the decision belongs to the maintainer.

SABOTAGE 1 — the 2026-08-07 production bug verbatim: the lock-less fallback decides with an EMPTY state instead of reading it. ⚠️ IT ALSO RE-ENABLES `FALLBACK_DELIVERS_ONCE` SINCE 2026-08-20, AND THE REASON MATTERS: once the fallback stopped delivering `once` documents at all, this sabotage went GREEN — not because reading the state stopped mattering, but because a SECOND barrier now hides it. A negative-check that passes for a reason other than the one it tests has stopped testing anything. Re-enabling the old delivery restores exactly one barrier, so this run keeps measuring what it was written to measure: that the state is READ, never guessed. 🛑 Do not drop this constant to 'simplify' — the run would go green and prove nothing.

SABOTAGE 2 — session-store writes without tmp+rename: the destination is truncated, a crash in that window leaves it EMPTY forever and everything already delivered is re-delivered. Run on the candidate-fix baseline so the red is attributable to the write alone.

SABOTAGE 3 — the lock-less fallback WRITES the state and the queue. The lock serializes the writes; the read never needed it. NoWriteWithoutLock is listed FIRST on purpose: this sabotage ALSO destroys the queue (it overwrites it with its own fresh-only split, so queued segments vanish while being marked consumed) and would otherwise redden NeverConsumedWithoutDelivery first, hiding the structural cause behind one of its symptoms.
SABOTAGE 4 — a leader outliving the 2 s lock timeout. Two DIFFERENT splits of one invocation then coexist and the frames no longer reassemble. Names the residual window and its exact precondition.
ANTI-VACUITY 1 — the model really delivers something.
ANTI-VACUITY 2 — the lock-less path is really reachable. Without this, every invariant about the fallback would pass by vacuity.
ANTI-VACUITY 3 — the queue really carries a deferred segment. Without this, crash-recovery of the queue would be proven over an always-empty queue.

ROTATION IS NOT STARVATION. With a `dumb` corpus durably above capacity the queue NEVER stays empty — that is CORRECT (`dumb` = re-inject at every action) and must not be `fixed`. The required RED on QueueEventuallyEmpty is the proof that indefinite rotation is a real behaviour of the model, and it coexists with a GREEN OnceProgress in Transport.cfg: rotation is permitted, starvation is not.
